basisOfRecord.quote: We sampled 14 forest areas in the Metropolitan Region of Salvador and tested the effect of the landscapes’ proportion of forest cover, mean landscape isolation, and mean landscape shape complexity on the taxonomic and functional richness and the community composition of both groups.

measurementStatistic.quote: We sampled 14 forest areas in the Metropolitan Region of Salvador and tested the effect of the landscapes’ proportion of forest cover, mean landscape isolation, and mean landscape shape complexity on the taxonomic and functional richness and the community composition of both groups.
The observed richness in the forests varied from 34 to 65 species, and the estimated richness ranged from 50.2 to 96.5 (Supplementary Information Table S1).
